steps.en: OCMS gets the company hirer's email address from the data source
steps.id: OCMS mendapatkan alamat email company hirer dari sumber data
steps.why_en: The refresh from the data source is switched off everywhere; only the stored email is used.
steps.why_id: Pembaruan dari sumber data dimatikan di semua environment; hanya email tersimpan yang dipakai.

steps.en: OCMS finds each company hirer once and combines its notices in one email
steps.id: OCMS menemukan tiap company hirer sekali dan menggabungkan notice-nya dalam satu email
steps.why_en: Notices with different due dates for the same company still produce separate emails.
steps.why_id: Notice dengan tanggal jatuh tempo berbeda untuk company yang sama tetap menghasilkan email terpisah.

steps.en: Companies that opted out or have no valid email get no message
steps.id: Company yang opt-out atau tanpa email valid tidak dikirimi pesan

steps.en: The email lists the outstanding fines and refers to the third letter
steps.id: Email memuat denda yang belum dibayar dan merujuk ke surat ke-3
steps.why_en: The email wording is kept outside the code, so it cannot be confirmed.
steps.why_id: Redaksi email ada di luar code, jadi belum bisa dipastikan.

steps.en: The email reminder is sent to the company hirer in the batch run
steps.id: Email reminder dikirim ke company hirer dalam batch job
steps.why_en: The job and email sending are both switched off in production by configuration.
steps.why_id: Job dan pengiriman email sama-sama dimatikan di produksi lewat konfigurasi.
